title: Blow-ups of a bi-Lipschitz C¹ chart image converge to the classical tangent plane (Simon Remark 1.5(2); parent (P4))
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, B ⊆ ℝⁿ open, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^N of class C¹ on B, K-Lipschitz on B (K ∈ ℝ≥0), and c > 0 with c|u − u'| ≤ |ψ(u) − ψ(u')| for all u, u' ∈ B. Then for every u ∈ B the set ψ(B) has approximate tangent space T := range Dψ(u) at ψ(u) in the sense of Simon's Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (ψ(B)) (ψ(u)) T): finrank T = n and lim_{λ↓0} ∫_{η_{ψ(u),λ}(ψ(B))} f dHⁿ = ∫_T f dHⁿ for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (B : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (K : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ), IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ B → LipschitzOnWith K ψ B → 0 < c → (∀ u ∈ B, ∀ u' ∈ B, c * ‖u - u'‖ ≤ ‖ψ u - ψ u'‖) → ∀ u ∈ B, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (ψ '' B) (ψ u) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap)
